decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 7am -10pm, Monday to Saturday and 9am - 10pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 5 - Anti-vibration mountings and a three-stage filtration system, comprising grease, pre-filter and carbon absorption stages should be incorporated in the system and should be regularly maintained.

Condition : 6 - The extractor flue hereby approved shall not be operated until details of a scheme to control the emission of noise from the extract fan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be carried out from the premises.
description: Change of use from A1 (Retail) to A3 (Restaurant) and A5 (Takeaway).
